# Module `ldp.color`

> Color management beyond the parametric core: ICC profile import, capability discovery, and profile-to-description resolution. The compositor blends in linear light and tone-maps per output (BT.2390); this module exposes the client-facing surface of that pipeline.

Version range **1–1** · 2 interfaces · 1 requests · 3 events · 0 enums · 1 bitsets.

## Interfaces

### `ldp.color.color_manager`

Entry point for the color pipeline: capability discovery and ICC import. Profiles are resolved to parametric descriptions the server can composite with; the resolution result is reported back on the profile object.

*global (registry-advertised)*

### `ldp.color.color_profile`

An imported ICC profile. Attach it to a surface with `surface.set_color_profile` (core extension request, capability-gated) or query the parametric resolution via `description`.
